findings.title: .gitignore is corrupted with intra-word spaces and an invalid inline comment
evidence: .gitignore:9,10,14,17 'e nvironment', 'intention ally', 'too ls', 'Self-t est', 'out put', 'defau lt'
.gitignore:18 'deterministic-out/ # Lab audit ...' is parsed as a literal pattern, so deterministic-out/ is not ignored
findings.impact: Editor scratch files, scan output and WireGuard client configs are not ignored as intended; also lowers trust in the tree.
findings.recommendation: Restore the intended patterns and add a `git check-ignore` assertion to CI.

findings.title: Two tracked shell scripts lack the executable bit
evidence: git ls-files -s '*.sh' shows 100644 for tools/lab-vpn/deploy-lab-api.sh and tools/lab-vpn/lab-api-install.sh
findings.impact: `./script.sh` fails on Linux; Windows transfers silently drop the bit.
findings.recommendation: `git update-index --chmod=+x` both files and add a hygiene check.

report: Reviewed .gitignore, .gitattributes, exec bits, and file hygiene. .gitattributes LF policy is correct; no CRLF in the index.
